svg.title: One MM step for a single support point
svg.desc: Schematic of the Mak & Joseph MM update for one support point ξm: thin lines to each data row weighted by inverse distance, two unit repulsion arrows away from the other support points, and an accent arrow to the new position, all inside the bounding box of the data.

text.font-family: Pretendard, Helvetica, 'Helvetica Neue', 'Nimbus Sans', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: CLAMP BOX = bounding box of the data
